tasks.label: Restore Next public assets
tasks.command: git checkout origin/master -- src/image src/public/image; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force public/image | Out-Null; Copy-Item -Path src/image/* -Destination public/image -Recurse -Force; Copy-Item -Path src/public/image/* -Destination public/image -Recurse -Force

tasks.label: Copy Next public assets
tasks.command: git checkout origin/master -- src/image src/public/image && if not exist public\image mkdir public\image && xcopy /E /I /Y src\image public\image && xcopy /E /I /Y src\public\image public\image

tasks.label: Complete public image assets
tasks.command: robocopy src\public\image public\image /E /NFL /NDL /NJH /NJS /NC /NS; copy /Y "src\image\DALL·E 2025-03-17 15.40.37 - A blurred background image of a large congregation in a church setting. The image should have a spiritual ambiance with a mix of blue and orange light.webp" public\image\ >nul; exit /b 0
